children: Aurora announced progress toward commercial scale, targeting >30,000 driverless trucks by 2030 and exiting 2026 with ~200 driverless trucks in operation.
Hosting 2026 Analyst & Investor Day in Dallas and furnished the event presentation and press release on Form 8-K.
Plans to exit 2026 fully allocated with 200 driverless trucks in operation via TaaS; expects >1,000 by end-2027 and >30,000 by 2030.
Claims >500,000 driverless miles driven and current customer trucks averaging ~225,000+ miles/year, boosting utilization and TCO benefits.
Second‑generation hardware engineered for a 1M-mile lifespan, cuts costs >50%; Roush ramping up upfitting to ~20 trucks/week in October.
Targets breakeven gross margin on run-rate basis in 1H 2027 at ~500 trucks and projects $5B+ revenue with ~60% gross margin by 2030.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Aurora outlines 2030 plan to scale to 30,000 driverless trucks; targets breakeven gross margin by 1H 2027
